quotes.text: Among all tested combinations, the model using positions 3, 5, 6, and 7 achieved the highest F1 score of 0.67.
Implementing this model on the noiseless simulator resulted in an F1 score of 0.73 when mapped to the quantum states using QRAC 2:1 (10-qubit experiment).
MHC binding labels were assigned from quantitative or qualitative binding assay outcomes; immunogenicity labels required a positive functional T-cell readout
